import pandas as pd

def run(inputs: dict) -> dict:
    readings = inputs["readings"].copy()

    def is_bad(v):
        return pd.isnull(v) or v < 0 or v > 1000

    readings["_is_bad"] = readings["value"].apply(is_bad)

    grp = readings.groupby("batch_id")["_is_bad"]
    total = grp.transform("size")
    bad_count = grp.transform("sum")

    readings["_total"] = total
    readings["_bad_count"] = bad_count

    readings["_quarantine"] = (readings["_bad_count"] * 100) > (readings["_total"] * 20)

    readings["_reject_pct"] = (readings["_bad_count"] * 100.0 / readings["_total"]).round(2)

    orig_cols = ["batch_id", "reading_id", "sensor", "value"]

    quarantine_mask = readings["_quarantine"]
    quarantine_df = readings.loc[quarantine_mask, orig_cols + ["_reject_pct"]].copy()
    quarantine_df = quarantine_df.rename(columns={"_reject_pct": "batch_reject_pct"})

    non_quarantine = readings.loc[~quarantine_mask]

    clean_df = non_quarantine.loc[~non_quarantine["_is_bad"], orig_cols].copy()
    rejects_df = non_quarantine.loc[non_quarantine["_is_bad"], orig_cols].copy()

    return {
        "readings_clean": clean_df.reset_index(drop=True),
        "readings_rejects": rejects_df.reset_index(drop=True),
        "readings_quarantine": quarantine_df.reset_index(drop=True),
    }
